# MatrixQR Digital Menu Generator

> Free online tool that converts menu images into digital QR codes for restaurants, cafes, and bars. All image processing runs 100% client-side in the browser with zero server storage.

## Core Features
- Instant Image to QR: Convert JPG, PNG, or WEBP menu images (up to 10MB) into scannable QR codes.
- Privacy First: 100% client-side processing — no image data is stored on remote servers.
- Free & Unlimited: No user registration, payment, or account creation required.

## Key Links
- [Digital Menu Generator](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Free digital menu QR code generator web application.
